sentences.en: Charles Walcot investigated the magnetic compass bearing sense in pigeons.
sentences.zh: 查尔斯·沃克特调查了鸽子的磁罗盘方向感。

sentences.en: A committee has been set up to investigate the problem.
sentences.zh: 已经成立了一个委员会来调查这个问题。

sentences.en: The police are now investigating the cause of the accident.
sentences.zh: 警方正在调查事故的原因。

mnemonic: 联想记忆：invest（投资）+i+gate（大门）→调查是通往投资的大门→调查
